sources.design: Mixed-methods guide; 65 high-quality RCTs, n 3796; patients 12, clinical experts 19; systematic-search cutoffMay 2022.
sources.population: Nonsurgical PFP; gradual retropatellar/peripatellar activity pain. Not tendon rupture or OA-specific evidence.
sources.comparator: Knee exercise vs wait/sham/placebo; other combinations vs knee exercise.
sources.coInterventions: Education central; tailored hip exercise, orthoses, taping, retraining/manual therapy as indicated.
sources.outcomes: Short-term knee-targeted pain SMD 1.16 (95%CI 0.66, 1.66), function 1.19 (0.51, 1.88). Combined hip/knee pain evidence very-low certainty. No adequately tested high-quality medium/long-term intervention evidence.
sources.uncertainty: May 2022 search not updated for 2024 synthesis; patient/expert preferences distinct from RCT efficacy. No-added-benefit findings do not imply ordinary movements harmful.
sources.limitations: May 2022 search not updated for 2024 synthesis; patient/expert preferences distinct from RCT efficacy. No-added-benefit findings do not imply ordinary movements harmful.

protocol.supervision: Individual assessment/education; no single supervision schedule.

sources.design: Multidisciplinary guideline, onlineJuly 2024, journal 2025; systematic reviews+RCTs, GRADE, informal consensus.
sources.population: Clinically distinguished PFP and PT; not generic anterior knee pain; nonoperative initial management.
sources.comparator: Exercise and multiple additional conservative treatments.
sources.coInterventions: Education/loading advice; additional treatment decisions after response review.
sources.outcomes: PFP: quadriceps/hip exercise 6–12 weeks; reconsider diagnosis if no improvement 12 weeks. PT: progressive quadriceps resistance>=12 weeks; heavy-slow preferred with alternate contractions for reactivity; review if no meaningful change 12 weeks.
sources.followUp: Recommended 6/12-week reassessment, not a trial follow-up.
sources.uncertainty: Evidence low/very-low; exercise reporting incomplete; informal consensus; scheduled guideline review after 2027, not automatic currentness guarantee.
sources.harms: Harms inconsistently reported; survey pain worsening is not randomized harm evidence.
sources.limitations: Evidence low/very-low; exercise reporting incomplete; informal consensus; scheduled guideline review after 2027, not automatic currentness guarantee.

protocol.execution: PFP: quadriceps/hip; PT: education/loading, strength, energy-storage, maintenance.
protocol.dose: No universal sets/reps/load; PT>=12 weeks strength, PFP 6–12 weeks.
protocol.supervision: PFP preferably partly PT-supervised; individualized management.
protocol.progression: Adjust intensity to pain; stage PT toward sport-dependent plyometrics then maintenance.
protocol.stoppingRules: No universal numeric threshold; reassess poor response after 12 weeks.

Primary 2023 full article/supplement direct fetches inaccessible; indexed partial methods and HE-2 printed p.9 inspected. Complete protocol and figure verification remain unresolved; no full protocol reconstructed.
No universal squat/lunge ban, patellofemoral load cap or angle restriction follows from these sources.
Guide efficacy search cutoffMay 2022 predates 2023 equivalence trial; both retained without treating later publication as automatic supersession.
Independent clinical review absent; doses are reported study protocols, not app prescriptions.
No universal contraindication follows from trial exclusion or another exercise showing benefit. No generic five-second progression or stretch strength-set credit.
